verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains substantive text extracted from several public canada.ca guidance pages: the IRCC landing page, work permits, the Start-up Visa page, and the processing-times page with its methodology. That implies the public reading surface is served as readable content rather than a login- or CAPTCHA-gated shell. However, nothing explicitly documents how these pages respond to a keyless agent with an identified user agent, and the interactive tools (eligibility questionnaire, processing-time selector) may need JS or form interaction. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of fetching with an identified bot user agent, confirmation of no bot-mitigation or CAPTCHA layer, confirmation that interactive checker content is server-rendered, any published crawler/robots policy.
